mapper.sql: T.TRIAL_NO, B.BUSINESS_NO, T.TITLE, T.PHASE, T.RECRUITMENT_STATUS, T.INSTITUTION_NAME, P.PROMOTION_NO, P.SUBSCRIPTION_NO, P.STATUS AS PROMOTION_STATUS, P.REJECT_REASON, P.START_DATE, P.END_DATE, S.END_DATE AS SUBSCRIPTION_END_DATE, P.CREATED_AT, P.UPDATED_AT
mapper.select: SELECT FROM BUSINESS B JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.BUSINESS_NO = B.BUSINESS_NO AND T.SOURCE_TYPE = 'BUSINESS' AND T.REVIEW_STATUS = 'APPROVED' LEFT JOIN TRIAL_PROMOTION P ON P.PROMOTION_NO = ( SELECT MAX(P2.PROMOTION_NO) FROM TRIAL_PROMOTION P2 WHERE P2.TRIAL_NO = T.TRIAL_NO AND P2.BUSINESS_NO = B.BUSINESS_NO ) LEFT JOIN BUSINESS_SUBSCRIPTION S ON S.SUBSCRIPTION_NO = P.SUBSCRIPTION_NO WHERE B.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND B.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY CASE P.STATUS WHEN 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 2 WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN 3 WHEN 'ENDED' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, T.TRIAL_NO DESC

SELECT FROM BUSINESS B JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.BUSINESS_NO = B.BUSINESS_NO AND T.SOURCE_TYPE = 'BUSINESS' AND T.REVIEW_STATUS = 'APPROVED' LEFT JOIN TRIAL_PROMOTION P ON P.PROMOTION_NO = ( SELECT MAX(P2.PROMOTION_NO) FROM TRIAL_PROMOTION P2 WHERE P2.TRIAL_NO = T.TRIAL_NO AND P2.BUSINESS_NO = B.BUSINESS_NO ) LEFT JOIN BUSINESS_SUBSCRIPTION S ON S.SUBSCRIPTION_NO = P.SUBSCRIPTION_NO WHERE B.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND B.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND T.TRIAL_NO = #{trialNo}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSINESS B JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.BUSINESS_NO = B.BUSINESS_NO JOIN TRIAL_PROMOTION P ON P.TRIAL_NO = T.TRIAL_NO AND P.BUSINESS_NO = B.BUSINESS_NO WHERE B.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND T.TRIAL_NO = #{trialNo} AND T.SOURCE_TYPE = 'BUSINESS' AND T.REVIEW_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND P.STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE')

SELECT SUBSCRIPTION_NO FROM ( SELECT S.SUBSCRIPTION_NO FROM BUSINESS B JOIN BUSINESS_SUBSCRIPTION S ON S.BUSINESS_NO = B.BUSINESS_NO WHERE B.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND B.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND S.PLAN_TYPE = 'PREMIUM' AND S.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (S.END_DATE IS NULL OR S.END_DATE > SYSDATE) ORDER BY S.SUBSCRIPTION_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_TRIAL_PROMOTION.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TRIAL_PROMOTION ( PROMOTION_NO, TRIAL_NO, BUSINESS_NO, SUBSCRIPTION_NO, STATUS, START_DATE, END_DATE, REJECT_REASON, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{promotionNo}, #{trialNo}, #{businessNo}, #{subscriptionNo}, 'PENDING', NULL, NULL, NULL, SYSDATE, NULL )
mapper.update: UPDATE TRIAL_PROMOTION SET STATUS = 'ENDED', END_DATE = CASE WHEN STATUS = 'ACTIVE' THEN NVL(END_DATE, SYSDATE) ELSE END_DATE END, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE') AND BUSINESS_NO = ( SELECT B.BUSINESS_NO FROM BUSINESS B WHERE B.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ) AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BUSINESS_SUBSCRIPTION S WHERE S.SUBSCRIPTION_NO = TRIAL_PROMOTION.SUBSCRIPTION_NO AND S.BUSINESS_NO = TRIAL_PROMOTION.BUSINESS_NO AND S.PLAN_TYPE = 'PREMIUM' AND S.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (S.END_DATE IS NULL OR S.END_DATE > SYSDATE) ) OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CLINICAL_TRIAL T JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = T.BUSINESS_NO WHERE T.TRIAL_NO = TRIAL_PROMOTION.TRIAL_NO AND T.BUSINESS_NO = TRIAL_PROMOTION.BUSINESS_NO AND T.SOURCE_TYPE = 'BUSINESS' AND T.REVIEW_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND B.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED' ) )
